# Pebril

> Pebril is an open-source, self-hosted image management project, licensed under MIT and currently in early development.

The website introduces Pebril and provides an interactive photograph timeline. The local-photo demonstration reads photographs and available capture dates only in the current browser session; it does not upload or persist them. Example photographs use fictional demonstration dates, not product release dates.

The project is not ready for production use. Consult the public repository for current capabilities and limitations. Planned features are not available merely because they appear on a roadmap.

## Project

- [Website](https://pebril.dev/): Project introduction and browser-only photograph demonstration.
- [Journal](https://pebril.dev/journal/): Notes on why Pebril exists, how it is designed, and what is still open. Chinese is authoritative; an English edition follows.
- [Public README](https://github.com/kserksi/Pebril/blob/dev/README.md): Current development status, supported functionality, limitations and evaluation instructions.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kserksi/Pebril): Source code and contribution context.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/kserksi/Pebril/blob/dev/LICENSE): Project license.

## Optional

- [Roadmap](https://github.com/kserksi/Pebril/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aroadmap): Public plans; not a list of completed features.
- [Project updates](https://x.com/pebril_dev): Official social account.
